I am HIGHLY disappointed in the duty of care at this general practice. I am in my first trimester of pregnancy and have been experiencing an allergic reaction all over my face, even around my eyes - incredibly itchy and uncomfortable. I walked all the way to the GP at 5;30pm because I was asked to come in there - I don't drive, so I had to walk half an hour there with my 1yo son which disturbed our dinner routine, but I was hopeful I'd get an answer for what is happening to my face. However, that was not the case. I was rushed whilst in there and told to just take piriton that I can get over the counter, I asked twice if this is ok in pregnancy he said yeah. Went to the pharmacy to buy some and the pharmacist refused to sell any antihistamines to me because it is potentially dangerous especially so early on in my pregnancy and ask me to get a prescription.

I felt let down and feel I cannot go to the GP for help at all. Bearing in mind I've struggled to get an appointment for weeks about my skin.

Awful - I will be moving me and my son to another practice.",null,[0,92]]]],[null,1722683232000000,1722870949000000,"Edited a year ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/3658819177920000546/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUmlOazlmVUZwUkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/3658819177920000546/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUmlOazlmVUZwUkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/3658819177920000546/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUmlOazlmVUZwUkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/3658819177920000546/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUmlOazlmVUZwUkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/3658819177920000546/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUmlOazlmVUZwUkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/3658819177920000546/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUmlOazlmVUZwUkVBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Miss Shepherd,
